title: Strict-perfect tensor model of completed finite reduction
statement: Let T, A and d be as in [def-weil-pbc-adic-coefficient-datum]. For every n : Nat there are a complex P of A_T-module sheaves, bounds a,b outside which its terms are zero, and degreewise splittings of its terms off finite products of the unit module as in [def-weil-pbc-strict-perfect-coefficient-package]. Tensor with this bounded complex, localized by [lem-weil-pbc-finite-projective-tensor-products], is naturally isomorphic to derived scalar extension along A_T → (A/I^(n+1))_T followed by exact restriction to A_T. The isomorphism is of functors on the entire unbounded derived category.

source.place: first proof sentence: bounded finite-projective representative of P_a; final sentence: tensor with the Roos products

proof.text: Convert the inherited coefficient hypotheses field by field to AdicCoefficientDatum, without changing the ring, ideal or quotients. Apply PerfectProjection.resolution_exists with X = Y = T and any fixed derived object. Its coefficient, boundedness, strict-perfect package and representsQuotient fields give a model of exactly the required quotient. The auxiliary injective representative is discarded.

Apply the tensor-model comparison to this coefficient complex, its given bounds and splitting package, and representsQuotient. Package the resulting natural isomorphism together with the actual coefficient model and its data.

proof_origin.place: Lean proof by S8: reuse PerfectProjection.resolution_exists for the model and apply the separate tensor-model comparison

mathlib_searches.results: Eight hits: ordinary AdicCompletion and its unit, profinite limit comparisons, UniformSpace.Completion.coeRingHom, and DerivedCategory.quotientCompQhIso. None states Koszul/strict-quotient reconstruction in a derived sheaf category.

mathlib_searches.results: Eight hits: projective tensor products, ordinary completion tensor formulas, and formally unramified module facts; none states the derived sheaf comparison.
CategoryTheory.Functor.leftDerivedUnique: uniqueness of universal left-derived functors; useful for the comparison, but does not supply a coefficient model or a Roos comparison.

Library: AdicCoefficientDatumCompleted, IntrinsicCompletionCompleted, FiniteProjectiveTensorProducts. The old KoszulReconstruction uses a different ring/site universe interface. Mathlib Adjunction.Basic supplies naturality and Derived.LeftDerived supplies uniqueness, but no completed-sheaf model comparison.

PerfectProjection.resolution_exists returns the required coefficient complex, bounds, StrictPerfectCoefficientPackageOnSite and representsQuotient. A fieldwise conversion of ProEtaleAdicCoefficientDatum to AdicCoefficientDatum makes all four fields definitionally the required types; checked by compilation.

lean.statement:
theorem completedReductionStrictPerfectModel (n : ℕ) :
    ∃ (P : CochainComplex (adicDatumModules T d) ℤ)
      (hb : ∃ a b : ℤ, ∀ j : ℤ, j < a ∨ b < j → IsZero (P.X j))
      (p : SheafOfModules.StrictPerfectCoefficientPackageOnSite
        ((adicLisseForget T).obj (adicDatumRing T d)) P),
      Nonempty (finiteProjectiveTensorRight T d P hb p ≅
        adicDatumReductionUnderlying T d n)
